# Kuailu explains: "Lithium on the head, steel recycling facility, race to digitize the layout?"

- Publication channel: China Daily News Network (central media)
- Published: 2026-06-15
- Original link: [https://cn.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202606/15/WS6a2fcd8fa310d709c2fb8330.html](https://cn.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202606/15/WS6a2fcd8fa310d709c2fb8330.html]

## Text
Operating alone, a $5 million regenerative resource company with a monthly flow of water, a 5 per cent control deviation in the acquisition pricing could result in a hidden loss of $250,000 in a single purchase chain. Kuailu Technology argued that price gaps were only the tip of a roughly managed iceberg, and that management problems such as inefficient turnover of stocks, poor customer accounting, fiscal compliance risks and production control irregularities would continue to affect business profits.

Industry development has long since left the savagery of “the more you earn” and digital transformation has become the core of corporate resilience to cyclical risks and the construction of profit barriers. The digital transformation of the deep tiller resource industry of Kuailu Technology, focal recovery, sorting, resource-based processing, full chain pain point, has led to many head lithium recovery, steel recovery head transformations, and below is a combination of the two hot track cases of scrap motor vehicles and lithium recovery, with digital landing values and landing paths.

End-of-life motor vehicles & scrap steel recycling: fine upgrading of the compliance industry

The end-of-life market for motor vehicles is breaking out when the old-for-new policy is adopted.

The traditional manual billing and verbal accounting of dismantling enterprises will be difficult to sustain because of retroactive non-compliance and non-retention of data, and digitization will be key to business compliance and sustainability.

In the case of a head end-of-life vehicle enterprise, the owner of the enterprise runs scrap motor vehicles, agricultural machine recycling and waste steel resource processing, dismantles more than 8000 scrap vehicles annually, more than 1,000 scrap agricultural machines, and 100 tons of scrap steel annual processing volume, which is the leading enterprise in the regional recycling economy.

As a typical waste steel recycling facility, the main management bottlenecks are the non-standardized material coding, the fragmentation of data, and the inability to meet the retroactive demand for downstream markets; and, secondly, the central dilemmas of output stocks, such as incalculability, and the lack of dynamic early warning mechanisms, also lead to incalculable cost-benefits, which seriously affect the speed of response to market fluctuations.

In response, the enterprise introduced a digital solution for the Kuailu + Regenerative Resources industry, which built an integrated control system for the mobile side plus the PC end, and provided access to the procurement warehouse, workshop dismantling, warehouse management, sales reconciliations, etc.

Mission-driven achievement of proactive business synergies and significant optimization of business targets after landing: reduction of time taken to trace materials of the whole class 83.33 per cent

Increased efficiency of cross-sectoral synergistic operations

55.56 per cent increase in inactive stock drive activity

Increased efficiency of workshop production 34.37 per cent

Dropping down core capacity

1. (a) One-yard full-chain traceability system: the raw materials vehicle automatically produces a unique identity code, the whole process is recorded in the bank, dismantled, released, sold and processed, and meets environmental requirements, taxes, multiple dimensions of end-of-life controls;

2. Classified smart stock alerts: multiple early warning labels for stock ceilings, floors, demurrage cycles, automatic system alerts to excess backlogs of goods and raw materials to avoid stock losses resulting from steel price fluctuations;

3. Dismantling BOM Intelligent Measurement: Enter a vehicle model, exit parameters automatically predetermine scrap steel after dismantling, spare parts output specifications and weights, pre-set pre-sale quotations, and change the lag pattern of the traditional full weight to account for costs.

Power cell recycling: fine regulation determines the enterprise ' s space

New energy vehicle stocks are rising year by year, power battery decommissioning cycles are concentrated, with about 350,000 tons decommissioned in 2025 and the main calibre of forecast retirements in 2030 at about 100-120 GWh. Mass decommissioned electric cores generate hundreds of billion-class urban mineral markets.

With the back-up management of the New Deal by power cells in the six sectors, the end-of-life of a car, the rigidity of a whole core tracer, the high external dependence of scarce metals, such as lithium nickel, and the continued strategic value of lithium resource recovery.

Under the track dividend, lithium recyclers still face multiple business challenges: Upstream recovery sources are fragmented, procurement offers are unorthodox, raw materials costs are affected by sharp fluctuations in lithium prices; production end dismantling processes are controlled, blending of inputs lacks standardized accounting tools, the whole process relies on spreadsheets, manual bookkeeping, half-finished products, cost-sharing of finished products is cumbersome and uneven; downstream environmental regulations are becoming increasingly stringent, informal small workshops are underpriced and formal plants often face shortages of raw materials when they are constrained by procurement costs.

The full-process fine-tuning of digitally becomes an important direction for an enterprise. In the case of a lithium lead company with Kuailu, its main focus lithium batteries were recycled and dismantled, through the digitized platform Kuailu, through procurement tests, warehousing, production dismantling, cost sharing, customer settlement of all six business scenarios, and close-ring control of more than 20 subdivisions of business lines, resulting in:

(b) Synchronize the sharing of information, inventory changes, production progress, cost composition, etc., and remove information from islands and support rapid decision-making;

Cost accounting is manual: material costs are automatically aggregated, multi-finished costs are automatically shared, and cost accounting efficiency and accuracy are significantly increased.

Compliance is integrated retroactively and policy requirements are met: Through the whole process of "Procedure for recycling production and sale of finished products", systematic recording of data at all stages, generation of retroactive reports, full compliance with policy requirements for full life cycle traceability, and evasion of compliance risks.

Kuailu ' s three core program advantages, enabling corporate long-term growth

In line with policy trends, the Kuailu AI+ Intellectual Solutions for the Regenerative Resources Industry, based on industry experience in deep-drive farming, can be sensibly weighed at the top of the ground, smart parks, closed doors, revenue billing, OA multi-type third-party systems, break the isolation of software and hardware data, one-stop coverage from raw materials to finished products, with the following three major features:

Advantage 1 |AI Smart Business Predicate, Full Chain Dynamic Wind Control

AI Depth embedding into the factory overpound, storage streaming, production discharge, relying on visual recognition + industry big data, intelligent pre-dismantling into material volume, connecting large commodity intelligence data to feed reference prices, helping enterprises to adjust their procurement tempo flexibly, and reducing the risk of raw material price fluctuations.

2 | batch bar code global retroactive, no concerns about compliance

A two-coding control system that allows full chain tracing of raw materials sources, workshop processing, finished stock, automatic archiving of accounts, easy response to regulatory needs such as environmental audits, tax verification, back-to-back platform reporting, etc., and circumventing compliance penalties from the root causes.

3-year-old industry customized products, adapted to break down the demand for tracks

Customization of BOM models for end-of-life vehicles, agricultural machinery, lithium electricity, etc., supports customized development based on product-specific smart output data, taking into account the light-quantified up-line requirements of small and medium-sized processing plants and the deep deployment of multi-united plants.

From purchasing smart prices, over-pounding, stock dynamics alerts, full chain tracking, one-key accounting, operating data boards, six core scenarios digitally landed, helping regenerative resource enterprises to move completely out of empirical management constraints.

In an environment of strong industry regulation and increased stock competition, digitization has moved from an enterprise’s options for upgrading to a need to cross the industry. In the future, Kuailu Technology continues to be an iterative AI digital product, helping to increase the number of recycling enterprises moving from rough operations to refined intelligence operations, moving from passive compliance to active profit growth.
